meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: Claude 会把积压的 GitHub issue 按根本原因分成几组, 每组开一个主 issue 和对应设计文档, 把所有子 issue 关闭并附上统一的重定向评论, 再为每组生成一个能一次性关闭整组问题的 PR。
howto.when: 当 GitHub 仓库有 20 个以上开放 issue 且感觉像重复或同根源, 或用户要求整理、聚类、去重等, 或想判断新 bug 是否属于已有计划时触发。

say.text: 把这 80 个 issue 按根本原因聚类成计划主问题。
新报的 bug #123 属于哪个现有计划?
为这个计划生成一个捆绑修复的 PR, 列出所有子 issue。

howto.what_en: Claude clusters the GitHub issue backlog by root cause into plan-master issues, closes each child with a standardized redirect comment, and prepares one atomic PR per cluster that auto-closes all its children.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a repo has 20+ open issues that look duplicated or share root causes, when the user asks to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe issues, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster these 80 issues by root cause into plan masters.
say_en.note: Claude reads all issues and comments, then creates masters and closes children.

say_en.text: Does bug #123 belong to an existing plan?
say_en.note: Claude matches it to a master and appends a Round N comment.

say_en.text: Generate a bundled PR for this plan, listing all children.
say_en.note: Claude writes a PR description with Closes #N for each child.
